context_files_read.purpose: Repository controlling instructions and safety boundaries.
key_findings: Machine-readable artifacts are the product; HTML, Markdown, CSV, and charts are views over versioned artifacts.
Missing metrics must be encoded explicitly as MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON and values must not be invented.
P14 is opt-in only and must not be run by default.

context_files_read.purpose: Project phase-loop entry point and artifact discipline.
key_findings: Automatic phases stop at P13; P14 requires explicit opt-in environment setup.
Report layer may read artifacts but must not become the source of truth.
Required project interface includes the existing report command, but L05 needs loop-engineering reports rather than only P09 phase reports.

context_files_read.purpose: Loop controller startup and per-stage reread obligations.
key_findings: Each stage must reread controlling files and write stage-scoped artifacts.
Stage completion requires previous harness, current harness, validation, review, anti-regression, commit, and push.
This subagent role only performs requirements and gap analysis.

context_files_read.purpose: Subagent output contract.
key_findings: requirements_analyst must output a JSON file under the stage subagents directory.
The JSON must include context read, findings, proposed harness, implementation plan, acceptance criteria, risks, forbidden shortcuts, commands, verdict, and notes.
Requirements analysis must not write implementation code.

context_files_read.purpose: Harness, artifact-first, and anti-regression policy.
key_findings: Current stage harness should prioritize schema, artifact validation, report visualization golden tests, and provenance tests.
Reports must read machine-readable artifacts, not Markdown or prior rendered views.
Anti-regression must block weakened tests, schemas, real coverage requirements, or historical gate manipulation.

context_files_read.purpose: L05 stage definition.
key_findings: L05 must render audit results, metric catalog, coverage matrix, scale ladder, and P13 timing into readable report and visualization artifacts.

Required outputs are index.html, coverage_matrix.csv, coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, p13_timing_waterfall.svg, missing_metrics.csv, and provenance_graph.json under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
All visualizations must be generated from JSON, JSONL, or CSV artifacts and must not hardcode numeric values.

context_files_read.purpose: Relevant validation command list.
key_findings: L05-specific validation expects tests/report, tests/visualization, and scripts/render_audit_report.py.
Real Valkey and 1000 dry-run commands are documented separately and are not required for L05 requirements analysis.
Baseline validation includes safety scan, compileall, CI tests, and loop-engineering validation.

context_files_read.purpose: Loop artifact layout and state contract.
key_findings: Subagent output belongs at artifacts/loop_engineering/stages/L05_REPORTING_V2_FOR_AUDIT_RESULTS/subagents/requirements_analyst.json.
Loop reports belong under artifacts/loop_engineering/reports.
Stage results should record visualizations added and known missing metrics.

key_findings: Machine-readable source inputs exist: audit_report.json, provenance_graph.json, metric_catalog.json, coverage_matrix.json, p13_p14_scale_audit.json, P13 scale ladder, and P13 timing breakdown artifacts.
Existing scripts/render_audit_report.py and tests/visualization are absent.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing report renderer capability.
key_findings: Existing renderer is P09-analysis-specific and produces phase-local metrics.csv, missing_metrics.csv, baseline_comparison.csv, metric_chart.svg, report.md, index.html, and report_index.json.
It is not sufficient for L05 because it does not consume audit_report.json, metric_catalog.json, coverage_matrix.json, p13_p14_scale_audit.json, scale_ladder_report.json, or P13 timing artifacts.
Patterns worth preserving include deterministic CSV/SVG/HTML generation, HTML escaping, and report_index entries with sha256.

They do not cover loop-engineering index.html, coverage_matrix.csv, heatmap SVG, scale ladder SVG, timing waterfall SVG, or provenance links.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing metric catalog tests.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing coverage matrix tests.

context_files_read.purpose: Existing provenance graph tests.

implementation_plan.step: Add a loop-engineering report renderer that reads the existing JSON source artifacts from artifacts/loop_engineering/reports and P13 phase artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: L05 needs a deterministic renderer for audit, metric, coverage, scale, timing, and provenance views; extending or wrapping the existing report package is preferable to embedding ad hoc rendering in tests.

implementation_plan.step: Generate coverage_matrix.csv and missing_metrics.csv directly from coverage_matrix.json and metric_catalog.json.
implementation_plan.rationale: CSV outputs should be readable views over existing machine-readable artifacts and should preserve source pointers, reasons, and dry-run/real coverage flags.

implementation_plan.step: Generate coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, and p13_timing_waterfall.svg with embedded labels/data attributes sourced from JSON.
implementation_plan.rationale: SVGs are required views and should be testable without image rasterization by asserting stable text, ordering, status classes, and source-derived values.

implementation_plan.step: Generate index.html as the navigation surface over audit summary, coverage matrix, missing metrics, scale ladder, P13 timing, P14 boundary, and provenance links.
implementation_plan.rationale: The HTML report should make the existing audit/metric/provenance artifacts readable while preserving source artifact links and missing/skipped semantics.

implementation_plan.step: Add report/visualization tests before implementation and keep them source-driven.
implementation_plan.rationale: The L05 harness must fail before the renderer exists and must verify required outputs, missing semantics, dry-run boundaries, and provenance references.

implementation_plan.step: Ensure generated views are either reflected in an index/report metadata artifact or traceable through source links without changing historical phase/gate artifacts.
implementation_plan.rationale: L05 required outputs include provenance_graph.json, but the graph remains the source artifact; HTML/CSV/SVG must not become measured metric sources.

acceptance_criteria: The L05 renderer writes artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/index.html, coverage_matrix.csv, coverage_heatmap.svg, scale_ladder.svg, p13_timing_waterfall.svg, missing_metrics.csv, and preserves provenance_graph.json.

Every L05 rendered output is generated from audit_report.json, metric_catalog.json, coverage_matrix.json, p13_p14_scale_audit.json, provenance_graph.json, scale_ladder_report.json, and P13 timing JSON artifacts or from CSV generated from those JSON artifacts.

coverage_matrix.csv contains one row per coverage_matrix.json entry with stable headers including layer, surface, status, evidence_class, metric_count, real_valkey_coverage, dry_run_only, reason, and source_artifacts.
coverage_heatmap.svg visually and textually distinguishes COVERED, MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, dry-run-only, and real Valkey coverage while preserving coverage_matrix.json layer/surface order.
missing_metrics.csv includes all metric_catalog.json metrics whose value_status is MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET, with non-empty reason fields and source artifact references.
scale_ladder.svg renders the P13 50-node and 100-node rungs, observed node counts, PASS status, real evidence paths, and Valkey version information from scale_ladder_report.json.

p13_timing_waterfall.svg renders 50-node and 100-node timing summaries including setup, cluster create, replica config, probes, cleanup, artifact write, total gate, accounted/unattributed seconds, and explicit MISSING diagnostic probe values.

index.html exposes audit summary counts, historical/non-blocking findings, metric summary counts, coverage summary, P14 dry-run boundary, P13 rung status, links or textual paths to source artifacts, and embedded or linked SVG/CSV outputs.
Generated HTML escapes source text; generated CSV uses deterministic headers and ordering; generated SVG is deterministic and non-empty.
No L05 work runs P14, sets VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, starts real Valkey clusters, invokes valkey_e2e_gate.py, invokes fault_safety_gate.py, or invokes fault_failover_gate.py.
Existing audit, provenance, metric catalog, coverage matrix, P13/P14 scale audit, and P09 report tests continue to pass without weakening schemas or previous assertions.
risks: Rendering code could accidentally treat CSV/HTML/SVG as authoritative data sources; tests must assert source JSON drives all numeric/status values.
The 1000-dry-run layer could be visually conflated with real coverage; heatmap and HTML must mark dry-run-only and real_valkey_coverage false.
Missing timing values such as diagnostic_full_probe_duration_seconds could be converted to zero during chart layout; renderer must encode them as MISSING with a visible reason or label.
Golden tests can become brittle if they compare full SVG/HTML documents with timestamps; prefer stable headers, labels, data attributes, and source-derived snippets.
Existing P09 renderer could be overgeneralized in a way that breaks P09 phase report behavior; keep L05 additions additive and covered by existing tests.
Provenance graph regeneration could reorder or modify existing graph semantics; preserve existing PASS graph and only add report references where explicitly supported by tests.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not hardcode coverage counts, metric values, P13 timings, node counts, or Valkey versions in HTML/CSV/SVG outputs.
Do not parse Markdown or existing rendered report files as source data.
Do not edit historical phase artifacts or gate results to make reports easier to render.
Do not mark MISSING, SKIPPED_WITH_REASON, or NO_BASELINE_YET metrics as measured values.
Do not count P14 or the 1000-dry-run layer as real Valkey coverage.
Do not run P14, set VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, or invoke real/fault wrapper scripts for this reporting stage.
Do not weaken schemas, tests, codex loop policy, phase manifests, or prior harness controls.
Do not omit provenance/source artifact paths and hashes from the readable report when the source artifacts provide them.
notes: Requirements are clear and not blocked. The source artifacts needed for L05 are present and previous harness passed; the main implementation gap is an additive loop-engineering renderer plus report/visualization harness. This analysis intentionally did not edit source files, run P14, or invoke real/fault wrappers.
